description: Change a cart line by its index (from view_cart): set qty (0 removes), or switch size/fabric. Args: index, qty?, size?, fabric?.

fabric.description: New fabric for this line (must be available for the product).

index.description: Zero-based cart line index from view_cart.

size.description: New size for this line (must be available for the product).

name: update_cart_item

checkout_url.description: Cart page URL for the human.

error.description: Present instead of a cart when the call failed (bad index, unavailable size, ...).

items.description: Cart lines in index order — this index is what update_cart_item takes.

custom.description: True when the line is a user-generated custom print.

subtotal.description: Sum of price x qty over all lines, USD.

title: Update cart line
